panel.askAgentTitle: The agent figures out how to run this project and writes .aiguillage/settings.toml
panel.askAgentPrompt:
Aiguillage's Run tab doesn't know how to run this project. Look at the repo, work out the command that starts the app in development (server, CLI, desktop app, etc.), then create `.aiguillage/settings.toml` at the repo root:

```toml
[scripts]
setup = "…"  # only if dependencies must be installed first, otherwise remove this line

[scripts.run.dev]
command = "…"
default = true
```

If the app listens on a port, use $AIGUILLAGE_PORT (also exported as $PORT). Add more `[scripts.run.<name>]` entries if useful. Don't start a long-running process yourself; just make sure the command is right.
